/*insertMasterCmClSalesTaxSum_KEPTITEM*/
INSERT INTO KEPTITEM /* 세금계산서 품목정보 */ ( TAX_BILL_NO , ITEM_SEQ , REMARK_DESCRIPTION , REMARK_SPECIFICATION , REMARK_QTY , REMARK_PRICE , SUPP_PRICE , TAX_PRICE , REMARK_DATE ) VALUES ( #{order_no} , '000001' , 'MRO용품외' , '' , '' , '' , TRUNC(#{supp_price}) , TRUNC(#{supp_price} * 0.1) , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') )

/*insertMasterCmClSalesTaxSum_BillCloseList*/
MERGE INTO BILL_CLOSE_USER_LIST A USING ( SELECT (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AS LEGACY_USER_ID, #{issue_date} AS BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, 'AR' AS CLOSE_TYPE, #{buyer_code} AS BUYER_CODE FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.LEGACY_USER_ID = B.LEGACY_USER_ID AND A.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH = B.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH AND A.CLOSE_TYPE = B.CLOSE_TYPE AND A.BUYER_CODE = B.BUYER_CODE ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( LEGACY_USER_ID, BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, CLOSE_TYPE, SEQ, KEP_DEPT, BUYER_CODE, AGENT_CODE, CLOSE_CMPL_YN ) VALUES ( (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}), #{issue_date}, 'AR', (SELECT NVL(MAX(SEQ),0) +1 FROM BILL_CLOSE_USER_LIST WHERE LEGACY_USER_ID = (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AND BILL_CLOSE_MONTH = #{issue_date} AND CLOSE_TYPE = 'AR' ), #{dept_code}, #{buyer_code}, '', 'N' )
